scope: Corollary 1.3 (Model-ball Faber–Krahn and Saint–Venant comparisons) of the manuscript “Generalized Cartan–Hadamard isoperimetry and Euclidean equality rigidity” (preprints/Generalized-Cartan-Hadamard-isoperimetry-and-Euclidean-equality-rigidity-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 337 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a7310d708fef81ea), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let n ≥ 2, κ ≤ 0 and 1 < p < ∞. Let (Mn, g) be complete, simply connected, smooth and without boundary, with secg ≤ κ. For a nonempty smooth domain D ⋐ M, let Bκ(|D|) be a geodesic ball of volume |D| = Volg(D) in the simply connected n-dimensional space form of curvature κ. Then λ1,p(D) ≥ λ1,p ( Bκ(|D|) ) , Tp(D) ≤ Tp ( Bκ(|D|) ) .
